1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2	"""Offline target planner and replay evidence reconciler.
     3	
     4	Implements the synthetic residential IPv6 evidence contract described in
     5	/app/instruction.md.  Two subcommands are provided:
     6	
     7	    plan MANIFEST.json
     8	    replay MANIFEST.json RESPONSES.jsonl
     9	
    10	Both commands print exactly one JSON object on stdout and exit 0 on success.
    11	Invalid arguments, an invalid manifest, unreadable input, or a whole-file
    12	size/line limit violation exit 2 with an empty stdout and a diagnostic on
    13	stderr.  Malformed individual replay rows are quarantined instead of failing
    14	the command.  No packets are ever sent; every address is documentation
    15	space (2001:db8::/32, RFC 3849).
    16	"""
    17	
    18	import argparse
    19	import hashlib
    20	import ipaddress
    21	import json
    22	import math
    23	import re
    24	import sys
    25	
    26	MANIFEST_MAX_BYTES = 1024 * 1024
    27	LOG_MAX_BYTES = 96 * 1024 * 1024
    28	LOG_MAX_LINES = 300000
    29	LOG_MAX_LINE_BYTES = 4096
    30	
    31	SEED_MAX = (1 << 64) - 1
    32	START_MS_MAX = 10 ** 12
    33	TOTAL_SUBNETS_MAX = 2048
    34	MAX_PROBE_ID_LEN = 200
    35	
    36	DOC_PREFIX_INT = 0x20010DB8 << 96          # 2001:db8::/32
    37	ID_PATTERN = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,31}")
    38	ASCII_WHITESPACE = " \t\n\r\x0b\x0c"
    39	
    40	MANIFEST_KEYS = frozenset(
    41	    ("version", "seed", "low_count", "attempts", "spacing_ms", "timeout_ms",
    42	     "windows"))
    43	WINDOW_KEYS = frozenset(("id", "start_ms", "scopes"))
    44	SCOPE_KEYS = frozenset(("id", "prefix", "subnets"))
    45	ROW_KEYS = frozenset(("probe_id", "received_ms", "target", "source", "type",
    46	                      "code"))
    47	
    48	ROLE_LOW = "low"
    49	ROLE_CANARY = "canary"
    50	
    51	# Field offsets inside a scheduled probe record.
    52	P_ID, P_WINDOW, P_SCOPE, P_SUBNET, P_TARGET, P_ROLE, P_SLOT, P_ATTEMPT, \
    53	    P_SENT, P_DEADLINE, P_SEGMENT = range(11)
    54	
    55	
    56	class InvalidInput(Exception):
    57	    """Invalid argument, invalid manifest, unreadable or oversized input."""
    58	
    59	
    60	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    61	# JSON helpers (duplicate keys and nonfinite numbers are rejected)
    62	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    63	
    64	def _reject_constant(value):
    65	    raise ValueError("nonfinite JSON number: %s" % (value,))
    66	
    67	
    68	def _parse_float(text):
    69	    value = float(text)
    70	    if math.isinf(value) or math.isnan(value):
    71	        raise ValueError("nonfinite JSON number")
    72	    return value
    73	
    74	
    75	def _unique_object(pairs):
    76	    result = {}
    77	    for key, value in pairs:
    78	        if key in result:
    79	            raise ValueError("duplicate JSON key: %s" % (key,))
    80	        result[key] = value
    81	    return result
    82	
    83	
    84	def decode_json_strict(text):
    85	    """Decode JSON text rejecting BOMs, duplicate keys and nonfinite numbers."""
    86	    if text.startswith("\ufeff"):
    87	        raise ValueError("unexpected byte order mark")
    88	    return json.loads(text, object_pairs_hook=_unique_object,
    89	                      parse_constant=_reject_constant,
    90	                      parse_float=_parse_float)
    91	
    92	
    93	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    94	# IPv6 helpers
    95	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    96	
    97	def _has_forbidden_characters(text):
    98	    if "%" in text:
    99	        return True
   100	    for char in text:
   101	        if char in ASCII_WHITESPACE:
   102	            return True
   103	    return False
   104	
   105	
   106	def parse_address(text, cache=None):
   107	    """Return the 128 bit integer of an in-range IPv6 address, else None."""
   108	    if not isinstance(text, str) or not text:
   109	        return None
   110	    if cache is not None:
   111	        try:
   112	            return cache[text]
   113	        except KeyError:
   114	            value = parse_address(text, None)
   115	            cache[text] = value
   116	            return value
   117	    if _has_forbidden_characters(text):
   118	        return None
   119	    try:
   120	        address = ipaddress.IPv6Address(text)
   121	    except (ValueError, RecursionError):
   122	        return None
   123	    value = int(address)
   124	    if (value >> 96) != 0x20010DB8:
   125	        return None
   126	    return value
   127	
   128	
   129	def parse_prefix(text):
   130	    """Return (network_base_int, prefixlen) for a valid manifest prefix."""
   131	    if not isinstance(text, str) or not text:
   132	        return None
   133	    if "/" not in text:
   134	        return None
   135	    if _has_forbidden_characters(text):
   136	        return None
   137	    try:
   138	        network = ipaddress.IPv6Network(text, strict=True)
   139	    except (ValueError, RecursionError):
   140	        return None
   141	    if network.prefixlen not in (56, 64):
   142	        return None
   143	    base = int(network.network_address)
   144	    if (base >> 96) != 0x20010DB8:
   145	        return None
   146	    return base, network.prefixlen
   147	
   148	
   149	def format_address(value):
   150	    return str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(value))
   151	
   152	
   153	def format_network(base):
   154	    return str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(base)) + "/64"
   155	
   156	
   157	def derive_canary_iid(seed, window_id, scope_id, canonical_network):
   158	    """Derive the canary interface identifier for one selected /64."""
   159	    payload = "ipv6-evidence-v1\n%d\n%s\n%s\n%s\n" % (
   160	        seed, window_id, scope_id, canonical_network)
   161	    digest = hashlib.sha256(payload.encode("ascii")).digest()
   162	    return int.from_bytes(digest[:8], "big") | (1 << 63)
   163	
   164	
   165	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   166	# Input loading
   167	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   168	
   169	def read_limited(path, limit):
   170	    """Read a regular file, refusing anything above the whole-file limit."""
   171	    with open(path, "rb") as handle:
   172	        data = handle.read(limit + 1)
   173	    if len(data) > limit:
   174	        raise InvalidInput("%s: file exceeds %d byte limit" % (path, limit))
   175	    return data
   176	
   177	
   178	def load_manifest(path):
   179	    """Read and JSON-decode the manifest, enforcing its whole-file limit."""
   180	    data = read_limited(path, MANIFEST_MAX_BYTES)
   181	    if data.startswith(b"\xef\xbb\xbf"):
   182	        raise InvalidInput("%s: manifest starts with a byte order mark" % (path,))
   183	    try:
   184	        text = data.decode("utf-8")
   185	    except UnicodeDecodeError:
   186	        raise InvalidInput("%s: manifest is not valid UTF-8" % (path,))
   187	    try:
   188	        return decode_json_strict(text)
   189	    except (ValueError, RecursionError) as error:
   190	        raise InvalidInput("%s: invalid manifest JSON: %s" % (path, error))
   191	
   192	
   193	def load_log_rows(path):
   194	    """Split the response log into physical lines, enforcing file limits."""
   195	    data = read_limited(path, LOG_MAX_BYTES)
   196	    if not data:
   197	        return []
   198	    rows = data.split(b"\n")
   199	    ends_with_lf = data.endswith(b"\n")
   200	    if ends_with_lf:
   201	        rows.pop()
   202	    if len(rows) > LOG_MAX_LINES:
   203	        raise InvalidInput("%s: log exceeds %d line limit"
   204	                           % (path, LOG_MAX_LINES))
   205	    last_index = len(rows) - 1
   206	    for index, row in enumerate(rows):
   207	        # Every line carries its LF except a final line without one.
   208	        length = len(row) + (0 if (index == last_index and not ends_with_lf)
   209	                             else 1)
   210	        if length > LOG_MAX_LINE_BYTES:
   211	            raise InvalidInput("%s: line %d exceeds %d byte limit"
   212	                               % (path, index + 1, LOG_MAX_LINE_BYTES))
   213	    return rows
   214	
   215	
   216	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   217	# Manifest validation
   218	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   219	
   220	def _is_integer(value):
   221	    return isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool)
   222	
   223	
   224	def _require_integer(value, low, high, description):
   225	    if not _is_integer(value) or value < low or value > high:
   226	        raise InvalidInput("manifest: %s must be an integer in [%d, %d]"
   227	                           % (description, low, high))
   228	    return value
   229	
   230	
   231	def _require_id(value, description):
   232	    if not isinstance(value, str) or not ID_PATTERN.fullmatch(value):
   233	        raise InvalidInput("manifest: invalid %s" % (description,))
   234	    return value
   235	
   236	
   237	def validate_manifest(manifest):
   238	    """Validate a decoded manifest and return a normalized description."""
   239	    if not isinstance(manifest, dict):
   240	        raise InvalidInput("manifest: top level value is not an object")
   241	    if set(manifest.keys()) != MANIFEST_KEYS:
   242	        raise InvalidInput("manifest: object keys must be exactly %s"
   243	                           % (sorted(MANIFEST_KEYS),))
   244	    version = manifest["version"]
   245	    if not _is_integer(version) or version != 1:
   246	        raise InvalidInput("manifest: version must be the integer 1")
   247	    seed = _require_integer(manifest["seed"], 0, SEED_MAX, "seed")
   248	    low_count = _require_integer(manifest["low_count"], 1, 32, "low_count")
   249	    attempts = _require_integer(manifest["attempts"], 1, 3, "attempts")
   250	    spacing_ms = _require_integer(manifest["spacing_ms"], 1, 1000,
   251	                                  "spacing_ms")
   252	    timeout_ms = _require_integer(manifest["timeout_ms"], 1, 1000000,
   253	                                  "timeout_ms")
   254	    windows = manifest["windows"]
   255	    if not isinstance(windows, list):
   256	        raise InvalidInput("manifest: windows must be an array")
   257	    if len(windows) > 8:
   258	        raise InvalidInput("manifest: at most 8 windows are allowed")
   259	
   260	    window_records = []
   261	    seen_windows = set()
   262	    total_selected = 0
   263	    for window in windows:
   264	        if not isinstance(window, dict):
   265	            raise InvalidInput("manifest: window is not an object")
   266	        if set(window.keys()) != WINDOW_KEYS:
   267	            raise InvalidInput("manifest: window keys must be exactly %s"
   268	                               % (sorted(WINDOW_KEYS),))
   269	        window_id = _require_id(window["id"], "window id")
   270	        if window_id in seen_windows:
   271	            raise InvalidInput("manifest: duplicate window id %r" % (window_id,))
   272	        seen_windows.add(window_id)
   273	        start_ms = _require_integer(window["start_ms"], 0, START_MS_MAX,
   274	                                    "start_ms")
   275	        scopes = window["scopes"]
   276	        if not isinstance(scopes, list):
   277	            raise InvalidInput("manifest: scopes must be an array")
   278	        if len(scopes) > 32:
   279	            raise InvalidInput("manifest: at most 32 scopes per window")
   280	        scope_records = []
   281	        seen_scopes = set()
   282	        selected_networks = set()
   283	        for scope in scopes:
   284	            if not isinstance(scope, dict):
   285	                raise InvalidInput("manifest: scope is not an object")
   286	            if set(scope.keys()) != SCOPE_KEYS:
   287	                raise InvalidInput("manifest: scope keys must be exactly %s"
   288	                                   % (sorted(SCOPE_KEYS),))
   289	            scope_id = _require_id(scope["id"], "scope id")
   290	            if scope_id in seen_scopes:
   291	                raise InvalidInput("manifest: duplicate scope id %r in window %r"
   292	                                   % (scope_id, window_id))
   293	            seen_scopes.add(scope_id)
   294	            parsed = parse_prefix(scope["prefix"])
   295	            if parsed is None:
   296	                raise InvalidInput("manifest: invalid prefix %r in scope %r"
   297	                                   % (scope["prefix"], scope_id))
   298	            prefix_base, prefixlen = parsed
   299	            subnets = scope["subnets"]
   300	            if not isinstance(subnets, list):
   301	                raise InvalidInput("manifest: subnets must be an array")
   302	            if prefixlen == 64:
   303	                if (len(subnets) != 1 or not _is_integer(subnets[0])
   304	                        or subnets[0] != 0):
   305	                    raise InvalidInput(
   306	                        "manifest: a /64 scope must select exactly [0]")
   307	                selected_values = [0]
   308	            else:
   309	                if len(subnets) < 1 or len(subnets) > 256:
   310	                    raise InvalidInput(
   311	                        "manifest: a /56 scope must select 1 to 256 subnets")
   312	                selected_values = []
   313	                seen_subnets = set()
   314	                for subnet in subnets:
   315	                    if not _is_integer(subnet) or subnet < 0 or subnet > 255:
   316	                        raise InvalidInput(
   317	                            "manifest: subnet values must be integers 0-255")
   318	                    if subnet in seen_subnets:
   319	                        raise InvalidInput(
   320	                            "manifest: duplicate subnet %d in scope %r"
   321	                            % (subnet, scope_id))
   322	                    seen_subnets.add(subnet)
   323	                    selected_values.append(subnet)
   324	            selections = []
   325	            for subnet in selected_values:
   326	                base = prefix_base + (subnet << 64)
   327	                if base in selected_networks:
   328	                    raise InvalidInput(
   329	                        "manifest: selected /64 networks overlap in window %r"
   330	                        % (window_id,))
   331	                selected_networks.add(base)
   332	                selections.append((subnet, base))
   333	            total_selected += len(selections)
   334	            scope_records.append((scope_id, selections))
   335	        window_records.append((window_id, start_ms, scope_records))
   336	    if total_selected > TOTAL_SUBNETS_MAX:
   337	        raise InvalidInput("manifest: more than %d selected /64 networks"
   338	                           % (TOTAL_SUBNETS_MAX,))
   339	    return {
   340	        "seed": seed,
   341	        "low_count": low_count,
   342	        "attempts": attempts,
   343	        "spacing_ms": spacing_ms,
   344	        "timeout_ms": timeout_ms,
   345	        "windows": window_records,
   346	    }
   347	
   348	
   349	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   350	# Scheduling
   351	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   352	
   353	def build_schedule(valid):
   354	    """Return (segments, probes, index_by_id) for a validated manifest."""
   355	    seed = valid["seed"]
   356	    low_count = valid["low_count"]
   357	    attempts = valid["attempts"]
   358	    spacing_ms = valid["spacing_ms"]
   359	    timeout_ms = valid["timeout_ms"]
   360	
   361	    segments = []
   362	    probes = []
   363	    index_by_id = {}
   364	    for window_id, start_ms, scope_records in sorted(
   365	            valid["windows"], key=lambda record: record[0]):
   366	        ordinal = 0
   367	        for scope_id, selections in sorted(scope_records,
   368	                                           key=lambda record: record[0]):
   369	            for subnet, base in sorted(selections,
   370	                                       key=lambda record: record[0]):
   371	                canonical = format_network(base)
   372	                canary0 = derive_canary_iid(seed, window_id, scope_id,
   373	                                            canonical)
   374	                segment_index = len(segments)
   375	                segments.append((window_id, scope_id, subnet, base))
   376	                targets = []
   377	                for iid in range(1, low_count + 1):
   378	                    targets.append((ROLE_LOW, iid, iid, "low-%d" % (iid,)))
   379	                targets.append((ROLE_CANARY, canary0, 0, "canary-0"))
   380	                targets.append((ROLE_CANARY, canary0 ^ 1, 1, "canary-1"))
   381	                for role, iid, slot, label in targets:
   382	                    target = base | iid
   383	                    for attempt in range(attempts):
   384	                        probe_id = "%s/%s/%d/%s/%d" % (
   385	                            window_id, scope_id, subnet, label, attempt)
   386	                        sent_ms = start_ms + ordinal * spacing_ms
   387	                        probes.append((probe_id, window_id, scope_id, subnet,
   388	                                       target, role, slot, attempt, sent_ms,
   389	                                       sent_ms + timeout_ms, segment_index))
   390	                        index_by_id[probe_id] = len(probes) - 1
   391	                        ordinal += 1
   392	    return segments, probes, index_by_id
   393	
   394	
   395	def make_plan(manifest_path):
   396	    manifest = load_manifest(manifest_path)
   397	    valid = validate_manifest(manifest)
   398	    _segments, probes, _index = build_schedule(valid)
   399	    planned = []
   400	    for probe in probes:
   401	        planned.append({
   402	            "id": probe[P_ID],
   403	            "window": probe[P_WINDOW],
   404	            "scope": probe[P_SCOPE],
   405	            "subnet": probe[P_SUBNET],
   406	            "target": format_address(probe[P_TARGET]),
   407	            "role": probe[P_ROLE],
   408	            "slot": probe[P_SLOT],
   409	            "attempt": probe[P_ATTEMPT],
   410	            "sent_ms": probe[P_SENT],
   411	            "deadline_ms": probe[P_DEADLINE],
   412	        })
   413	    return {"version": 1, "probes": planned}
   414	
   415	
   416	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   417	# Replay
   418	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   419	
   420	def _row_schema_reason(obj):
   421	    if not isinstance(obj, dict) or set(obj.keys()) != ROW_KEYS:
   422	        return "schema"
   423	    probe_id = obj["probe_id"]
   424	    if not isinstance(probe_id, str):
   425	        return "schema"
   426	    if not probe_id or len(probe_id) > MAX_PROBE_ID_LEN:
   427	        return "schema"
   428	    if not isinstance(obj["target"], str) or not isinstance(obj["source"], str):
   429	        return "schema"
   430	    for key in ("received_ms", "type", "code"):
   431	        if not _is_integer(obj[key]):
   432	            return "schema"
   433	    return None
   434	
   435	
   436	def replay(manifest_path, responses_path):
   437	    manifest = load_manifest(manifest_path)
   438	    valid = validate_manifest(manifest)
   439	    segments, probes, index_by_id = build_schedule(valid)
   440	    low_count = valid["low_count"]
   441	    attempts = valid["attempts"]
   442	    rows = load_log_rows(responses_path)
   443	
   444	    address_cache = {}
   445	    diagnostics = []
   446	    accepted_rows = 0
   447	    duplicate_rows = 0
   448	    seen_tuples = set()
   449	    canary_hits = [set() for _ in segments]
   450	    # segment -> {iid: {attempt: [internal_flag, external_flag, sources, any]}}
   451	    low_evidence = [{} for _ in segments]
   452	
   453	    for number, raw in enumerate(rows, start=1):
   454	        reason = None
   455	        obj = None
   456	        try:
   457	            text = raw.decode("utf-8")
   458	            obj = decode_json_strict(text)
   459	        except (ValueError, RecursionError):
   460	            reason = "json"
   461	        if reason is None:
   462	            reason = _row_schema_reason(obj)
   463	        if reason is None:
   464	            target = parse_address(obj["target"], address_cache)
   465	            source = parse_address(obj["source"], address_cache)
   466	            if target is None or source is None:
   467	                reason = "address"
   468	        if reason is None:
   469	            index = index_by_id.get(obj["probe_id"])
   470	            if index is None:
   471	                reason = "unknown_probe"
   472	        if reason is None:
   473	            probe = probes[index]
   474	            if target != probe[P_TARGET]:
   475	                reason = "target_mismatch"
   476	        if reason is None:
   477	            received_ms = obj["received_ms"]
   478	            if not probe[P_SENT] <= received_ms < probe[P_DEADLINE]:
   479	                reason = "time"
   480	        if reason is None:
   481	            message_type = obj["type"]
   482	            code = obj["code"]
   483	            if not ((message_type == 129 and code == 0)
   484	                    or (message_type == 1 and 0 <= code <= 6)):
   485	                reason = "icmp"
   486	        if reason is not None:
   487	            diagnostics.append({"line": number, "reason": reason})
   488	            continue
   489	
   490	        key = (index, received_ms, target, source, message_type, code)
   491	        if key in seen_tuples:
   492	            duplicate_rows += 1
   493	            continue
   494	        seen_tuples.add(key)
   495	        accepted_rows += 1
   496	
   497	        segment = probe[P_SEGMENT]
   498	        if probe[P_ROLE] == ROLE_CANARY:
   499	            if message_type == 129 and source == target:
   500	                canary_hits[segment].add(probe[P_SLOT])
   501	            continue
   502	        per_target = low_evidence[segment].setdefault(probe[P_SLOT], {})
   503	        record = per_target.get(probe[P_ATTEMPT])
   504	        if record is None:
   505	            record = [False, False, set(), True]
   506	            per_target[probe[P_ATTEMPT]] = record
   507	        if message_type == 129:
   508	            if source == target:
   509	                record[0] = True
   510	        else:
   511	            if source != target:
   512	                record[1] = True
   513	                record[2].add(source)
   514	
   515	    out_segments = []
   516	    for segment_index, (window_id, scope_id, subnet, base) in enumerate(segments):
   517	        hits = sorted(canary_hits[segment_index])
   518	        per_segment = low_evidence[segment_index]
   519	        internal_set = set()
   520	        external_set = set()
   521	        for iid, per_target in per_segment.items():
   522	            if any(record[0] for record in per_target.values()):
   523	                internal_set.add(base | iid)
   524	            for record in per_target.values():
   525	                if record[2]:
   526	                    external_set.update(record[2])
   527	        overlap_set = internal_set & external_set
   528	        if 0 in hits and 1 in hits:
   529	            state = "alias_suspect"
   530	        elif overlap_set:
   531	            state = "ambiguous"
   532	        else:
   533	            state = "usable"
   534	        if state != "usable":
   535	            exposure = "excluded"
   536	        elif internal_set:
   537	            exposure = "observed_internal_reply"
   538	        else:
   539	            exposure = "inconclusive"
   540	
   541	        targets = []
   542	        for iid in range(1, low_count + 1):
   543	            per_target = per_segment.get(iid)
   544	            internal_attempts = []
   545	            external_attempts = []
   546	            external_sources = set()
   547	            responded = set()
   548	            if per_target:
   549	                for attempt, record in per_target.items():
   550	                    responded.add(attempt)
   551	                    if record[0]:
   552	                        internal_attempts.append(attempt)
   553	                    if record[1]:
   554	                        external_attempts.append(attempt)
   555	                    if record[2]:
   556	                        external_sources.update(record[2])
   557	            internal_attempts.sort()
   558	            external_attempts.sort()
   559	            silent_attempts = [attempt for attempt in range(attempts)
   560	                               if attempt not in responded]
   561	            if state == "alias_suspect":
   562	                classification = "alias_suspect"
   563	            elif state == "ambiguous":
   564	                classification = "ambiguous"
   565	            elif internal_attempts and external_attempts:
   566	                classification = "mixed"
   567	            elif internal_attempts:
   568	                classification = "internal"
   569	            elif external_attempts:
   570	                classification = "external"
   571	            else:
   572	                classification = "unknown"
   573	            targets.append({
   574	                "address": format_address(base | iid),
   575	                "classification": classification,
   576	                "internal_attempts": internal_attempts,
   577	                "external_attempts": external_attempts,
   578	                "external_sources": [format_address(value) for value
   579	                                     in sorted(external_sources)],
   580	                "silent_attempts": silent_attempts,
   581	            })
   582	        out_segments.append({
   583	            "window": window_id,
   584	            "scope": scope_id,
   585	            "subnet": subnet,
   586	            "network": format_network(base),
   587	            "state": state,
   588	            "exposure": exposure,
   589	            "canary_hits": hits,
   590	            "internal": [format_address(value) for value
   591	                         in sorted(internal_set)],
   592	            "external": [format_address(value) for value
   593	                         in sorted(external_set)],
   594	            "overlap": [format_address(value) for value
   595	                        in sorted(overlap_set)],
   596	            "targets": targets,
   597	        })
   598	
   599	    return {
   600	        "version": 1,
   601	        "accepted_rows": accepted_rows,
   602	        "duplicate_rows": duplicate_rows,
   603	        "diagnostics": diagnostics,
   604	        "segments": out_segments,
   605	    }
